explanation.ar: في معيار ISO 9126، يسمى المستوى الأعلى بخصائص الجودة (Quality characteristics)، وعددها 6 خصائص رئيسية.
explanation.en: The ISO/IEC 9126 standard formally structures software product quality into six top-level quality characteristics: Functionality, Reliability, Usability, Efficiency, Maintainability, and Portability. Each characteristic is further refined into subcharacteristics and measurable metrics.

explanation.ar: عوامل مراجعة المنتج (Product Revision) في نموذج ماكول هي ثلاثية الصيانة: سهولة الصيانة (Maintainability) + المرونة (Flexibility) + القابلية للاختبار (Testability).
explanation.en: Under McCall's framework, Product Revision focuses on how easily the software can be inspected, repaired, and enhanced. It consists of exactly three factors: 1. Maintainability: Effort required to locate and fix defects. 2. Flexibility: Effort required to modify the software for new operational needs. 3. Testability: Effort required to validate that the software performs its intended functions.

stem.ar: أي مما يلي ليس نموذج موثوقية برمجيات؟
stem.en: Which is not a software reliability model ?

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.43; publisher key p. 499

explanation.ar: النموذج الحلزوني (Spiral model) هو نموذج دورة حياة لتطوير البرمجيات (SDLC) يعتمد على إدارة المخاطر، وليس نموذجاً رياضياً لقياس الاعتمادية.
explanation.en: The Spiral model is an iterative, risk-driven Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) process model formulated by Barry Boehm. It is not a statistical software reliability growth model. Jelinski–Moranda and Musa's Basic execution time model are established reliability models.

explanation.en: With the exception of Level 1 (which has 0 KPAs), each mature level in the CMM comprises multiple Key Process Areas (KPAs): Level 2 has 6 KPAs, Level 3 has 7 KPAs, Level 4 has 2 KPAs, and Level 5 has 3 KPAs.

explanation.en: KPA stands for Key Process Area. In CMM, a Key Process Area identifies a cluster of related activities that, when performed collectively, achieve a set of goals considered critical for establishing process capability at that maturity level.

explanation.ar: تركز نماذج الاعتمادية على حالات الفشل (Failures) لأنها الحدث الديناميكي الحقيقي الذي يواجهه المستخدم ويؤثر على الخدمة في الواقع.
explanation.en: Dynamic software reliability models model the observable behavior of the software from the user's perspective; hence, the primary modeling emphasis is on failures (dynamic departure from required operation). Users experience failures, not passive latent faults residing silently in unexecuted source code.

stem.ar: البرمجيات لا تنكسر ولا تبلى مثل العتاد. ما رأيك؟
stem.en: Software does not break or wearout like hardware. What is your opinion ?

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.47; publisher key p. 499

explanation.ar: العبارة صحيحة تماماً (True): البرمجيات لا تهترئ ولا تبلى مادياً (Does not wear out) لأنها كيان منطقي غير خاضع لقوانين الاحتكاك والفيزياء.
explanation.en: True in the physical sense: software does not wear out through physical aging. It may become obsolete or fail when its environment or requirements change, but those changes are different from hardware wear-out.

explanation.ar: دالة الاعتمادية تُعرّف رياضياً بالنسبة إلى الزمن (Time).
explanation.en: Software reliability is mathematically defined as a time-dependent probability distribution $R(t)$ measuring the likelihood of failure-free operation over a specified operational time interval. Without specifying a temporal baseline (execution time, clock time, or calendar time), reliability has no mathematical meaning.

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.

explanation.ar: اختصار MTTF يعني متوسط زمن حدوث الفشل (Mean Time To Failure).
explanation.en: MTTF stands for Mean Time To Failure. It is the expected statistical value of the operational execution time of a software system before its next failure event occurs, defined as the integral of the reliability function: $$MTTF = \int_0^\infty R(t) \, dt$$

explanation.ar: تتكون سلسلة معايير ISO 9000 الأصلية من 5 مواصفات مرتبطة شهيرة (ISO 9000, 9001, 9002, 9003, 9004).
explanation.en: The original ISO 9000 series comprises five related standards: 1. ISO 9000: Quality management and quality assurance standards — Guidelines for selection and use. 2. ISO 9001: Model for quality assurance in design, development, production, installation, and servicing. 3. ISO 9002: Model for quality assurance in production, installation, and servicing. 4. ISO 9003: Model for quality assurance in final inspection and test. 5. ISO 9004: Quality management and quality system elements — Guidelines.
